rules.atlas_floor: the atlas v2 world entry's recorded noise_floor (the confirm's counts, which are the run's)
rules.dispersion: under TS: history_differs when agent_history_dispersion >= 0.05 and routed_share_dispersion >= 0.10 on >= 2/3 of the defined worlds, else history_flat
rules.fidelity: equivalent: |TS_w - MWWk_w| <= floor_w; first match: faithful (equivalent on >= 2/3) -> mixed (both or neither of the next two) -> fidelity_loss (TS < MWWk beyond the floor on >= 1/3) -> beyond_target (TS > MWWk beyond the floor on >= 1/3)
rules.floor: per comparison: max(atlas noise_floor, 3 SE of the run's own paired differences); the own SE only with >= 2 paired observations (episodes x replicates), else the atlas floor (n = 1 rule)
rules.means: per world: equal-weight mean over episodes of the replicate means
rules.primary: G_w = RR_w - TR_w; gap world: G_w > floor_w; rec_w = (TS_w - TR_w) / G_w; first match: no_gap (< 5 gap worlds) -> decoder (rec_w >= 2/3 on >= 2/3 of gap worlds) -> decoder_partial (median rec_w >= 1/3) -> not_decoder
rules.score_fidelity: per arm: median over episode rows of the per-row medians (Spearman, KL); top-1 decision-weighted; top-1 ties: first argmax
